{{Quote|Be careful with this one, Jano is a dangerous swoop gang leader.|[[Byxle Pedette]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TDC" />}}
'''Jano Bix''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] leader operating out of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], upon ordering four [[Gorg/Legends|gorg]] combos from [[Tasty Dried Critters]], the creatures attacked Bix. The spacer who delivered the order killed the gorgs and Jano Bix ate them anyway.<ref name="SWG:TDC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jano Bix was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TDC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Jano Bix was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
